name: Spoons
tagline: Pass cards round as fast as you can. Four of a kind? Quietly take a spoon — and watch the others.
rulesSummary: Be the last player in. Each round, whoever ends up without a spoon gets a letter: S, P, O, O, N. Spell SPOON and you're out.
Everyone holds four cards. There's one spoon fewer than players.
No turns: the dealer picks up from the deck, everyone else picks up what's passed to them. Pick up one, then pass one on to your left. The player on the dealer's right discards.
Get four of a kind and grab a spoon. Nobody is told, so keep an eye on the spoons!
Once a spoon is gone, anyone may grab one, four of a kind or not. Whoever is left without one gets a letter.
Grab the first spoon without four of a kind and you get the letter instead, and the round ends.
